data['Waste_value'] = data['Waste_value'].fillna(data['Waste_value'].mean())

# Compute neighborhood waste generation
neighborhood_waste = data.merge(adjacency, on='borough', how='left')
neighborhood_waste = neighborhood_waste.groupby('borough')['Waste_value'].transform(lambda x: x[adjacency['neighbor']].mean())

# Identify hot spots and cold spots
data['neighborhood_waste'] = neighborhood_waste
data['hot_spot'] = np.where((data['Waste_value'] > data['neighborhood_waste']) & (data['neighborhood_waste'] > data['Waste_value'].mean()), 'HH', np.nan)
data['cold_spot'] = np.where((data['Waste_value'] < data['neighborhood_waste']) & (data['neighborhood_waste'] < data['Waste_value'].mean()), 'LL', np.nan)

# Compute statistical significance
hot_spots = data[data['hot_spot'] == 'HH']
cold_spots = data[data['cold_spot'] == 'LL']

# Permutation test for hot spots
hot_spots['test_statistic'] = hot_spots['Waste_value'] - hot_spots['neighborhood_waste']
hot_spots['p_value'] = np.mean(np.random.permutation(hot_spots['test_statistic'].values) >= hot_spots['test_statistic'].values)

# Print the results
print(f"data_points_used = {len(data)}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {' '.join(identified_boroughs)}")
